create_standard_wav2vec2_masker: create a StandardWav2Vec2Masker with model_dim 768 and default temporal masking parameters
mask_wav2vec2_features_temporal: mask wav2vec 2.0 feature sequences with temporal masking using StandardWav2Vec2Masker forward pass
extract_masked_elements: extract masked elements from sequences using Wav2Vec2Masker extract_masked_elements static method
configure_spatial_masking: configure StandardWav2Vec2Masker with spatial masking by setting max_spatial_mask_prob to 0.1
customize_mask_factory: customize StandardWav2Vec2Masker by passing a custom RowMaskFactory instead of compute_row_mask
